targetReport.title: European System of Accounts 2010 (ESA 2010)
targetReport.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
targetReport.description: The EU's national accounts framework, enacted as Regulation (EU) No 549/2013. Article 1(2) sets out its two parts: 'a methodology (Annex A) on common standards, definitions, classifications and accounting rules that shall be used for compiling accounts and tables on comparable bases for the purposes of the Union' and 'a programme (Annex B) setting out the time limits by which Member States shall transmit to the Commission (Eurostat) the accounts and tables'. Unlike the international standards already in this corpus, ESA 2010 is a Regulation — member states do not adopt it by choice — which is why the EU branch was expected to produce supranational-to-national edges the Canada/US pair lacks. Annex B turned out to name tables and deadlines rather than publications; see the _dropped entries here and in eu-draft-budget.json.

targetReport.description: The EDP Regulation — the instrument that turns the Treaty's excessive deficit procedure into a statistical reporting regime, and the second EU Regulation in this corpus to be modelled as a node after esa-2010. targetReport.title: Council Regulation (EC) No 479/2009 on the application of the Protocol on the excessive deficit procedure
targetReport.description: The EDP Regulation — the instrument that turns the Treaty's excessive deficit procedure into a statistical reporting regime, and the second EU Regulation in this corpus to be modelled as a node after esa-2010. It matters here for Article 9, which compels into existence a published national document class that no other instrument this branch has followed produces: 'Member States shall provide the Commission (Eurostat) with a detailed inventory of the methods, procedures and sources used to compile actual deficit and debt data and the underlying government accounts' (Art. 9(1)), 'The inventories shall be updated following revisions in the methods, procedures and sources adopted by Member States' (Art. 9(3)), and 'Member States shall make their inventories public' (Art. 9(4)). Eurostat's own EDP inventories page states the consequence — 'Pursuant to Article 9 of Council regulation 479/2009 (as amended), all EU Member States are required to prepare and publish an EDP inventory' — and carries a live Inventory link for each of the 27. EUR-Lex titles it a '(Codified version)', codifying Council Regulation (EEC) No 3605/93. Note that the Regulation names no member state's inventory by title: AGENCY ONLY at exactly the point where a title would have produced a downward edge.
targetReport.cadence_note: Derived from an observed amendment record, not from a stated rate — see _open_questions. Adopted 25 May 2009; EUR-Lex lists exactly two consolidated versions, 19/08/2010 and 01/09/2014, with 01/09/2014 flagged as the current version. Two amendments across the 17 years to 2026.

release_schedule.note: April notification is provisional, October carries the revised annual figures. The underlying legal deadline (Reg. 479/2009 Art. 3(1)) is fixed at before 1 April and 1 October each year, so future cycles can be projected from that even without the exact transmission date.

targetReport.title: Goods and Services Tax (GST) administrative files
targetReport.description: GST remittance records, used to avoid surveying small manufacturers. IMDB record 2101: 'Managing response burden is an ongoing challenge for Statistics Canada. In an attempt to alleviate response burden, especially for small businesses, the MSM derives sales data for low-revenue establishments from Goods and Service Tax (GST) files using a ratio estimator.' results.window: Estimates of sales for fifteen census metropolitan areas (CMA) have been derived by using a small area estimation (SAE) technique based on a Fay-Herriot methodology.  雖然商品輸出入統計之主要資料須以海關之貿易統計為依據，惟兩者定義、範圍略有不同，須加調整；其不同點主要為海關以商品之是否進關與出關為統計基礎，而國民所得統計則以所有權之移轉為計算基礎。另海關貿易統計對於出口商品價值係按離岸價值(F.O.B.)計算，進口商品則按到岸價值(C.I.F.)計算，而國民經濟會計對於輸入商品依C.I.F.價值離析為F.O.B.價值、本國常住居民對輸入商品提供承運及保險服務價值，與非本國常住居民對輸入商品提供承運及保險服務價值等三項，其中本國常住居民對輸入商品提供承運及保險價值因非屬服務輸入，故於服務輸出設置相應項目以為對減。另輸出除F.O.B.價值之商品，與服務輸入相應對減項目外，亦將本國常住居民提供之輸出承運及保險價值列計服務輸出。此外，一般稱海關商品進出口之差額為「出(入)超」，而國民所得統計之商品及服務輸出入之差額稱「順(逆)差」。 回上一頁
